_about: Wording corrected after checking against search results (see data/verification_pilot.json). Applied by tools/clean_data.py. Each entry replaces one field of one record.

storm-king-art-center.why_flagged: Bloomberg Philanthropies is listed in Storm King's 2025 donor list in the Ambassador tier ($100,000+).

casa-frança-brasil-rio-de-janeiro.why_flagged: The former Casa França-Brasil now operates as Casa Brasil, with Petrobras as sponsor through its Novos Eixos call (Ícones da Cultura Brasileira line). The rename date is not confirmed.

state-tretyakov-gallery-moscow.watch: Director Zelfira Tregulova removed 9 Feb 2023 after a Ministry-forwarded complaint of 'destructive ideology' in the displays; Elena Pronicheva (daughter of an FSB general) replaced her; in Jan 2026 Olga Galaktionova (ex-ROSIZO, ex-Pushkin) took over. The Ministry cancelled the 9th Moscow Biennale at the New Tretyakov on 3 Nov 2022. The Gallery states 80+ companies and individuals support it.
